# Creatures & Wildlife

Toughness is the base HP (x1.5 on Undertow). Every threat has a non-combat answer: see *How to deal with it*.

| Creature | Where & when | Dangerous? | Toughness | How to deal with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tide-crab | Intertidal flats at low tide | Never on Cozy, and only when cornered | 8 HP | Tide-crabs flee from footsteps. Sneak (Ctrl) to get close, or hold kelp or fish as bait and press F to catch one. |
| Gull | Shores and docks by day | Steals a held raw fish if you stand still (not on Cozy) | can't be harmed | Gulls eye unattended fish. Keep moving or stow your catch. |
| Cave eel | Flooded sea cave after dark (any time on Undertow) | Yes: lunges at the water's edge (never on Cozy) | 40 HP | Cave eels shun light. Set a lamp or lantern by the water, sneak along the ledge (Ctrl), or come back by day. |
| Coastal hare | Grassland, day and dusk | No | can't be harmed | A coastal hare. It bolts at footsteps; sneak (Ctrl) to watch it graze. |
| Harbour seal | Beach flats at low tide; shallows otherwise | No | can't be harmed | A seal hauled out at low tide. Sneak (Ctrl) to get close before it slips back into the sea. |
| Puffin | Sea stacks and cliff tops by day | No | can't be harmed | A puffin colony. Sneak (Ctrl) and they'll let you sit among them. |
| Sea otter | Kelp beds and calm water near shore | No (can be befriended) | can't be harmed | A sea otter in the kelp. Stand still holding a raw fish and press F to offer it. |
| Grey heron | The shallows, dawn to dusk | No | can't be harmed | A heron fishing the shallows. Sneak (Ctrl) to watch it strike. |
| Humpback whale | Deep water far offshore, by day (rare) | No | can't be harmed | A whale far out to sea. Watch for its blow. |
| Red fox | Woods by day (den); raids pens at night | Never hurts players; takes ducks, eggs or feed | 14 HP | A fox is about! Lanterns keep it off, Pen Fences and closed gates keep it out, and a baited live trap catches it unharmed. |
| Stoat | Woods; raids coops at night | Never hurts players; steals eggs | 6 HP | A stoat after eggs! It squeezes through small gaps; light, Pen Fences and a baited live trap stop it. |
| Shore rat | Up from the tideline the nights after a storm | Never hurts players; eats food from open chests and crates | 4 HP | A shore rat after your stores! Sealed barrels keep food safe; a dock cat or a guard dog sees it off. |
| Sea eagle | High over the island by day | Never hurts players; stoops on ducks in the open (scatters them on Cozy) | 12 HP | A sea eagle! Roof the pen, put up a scarecrow, or stay near your ducks. |
